titulo: "Everyone Wants to Be a DJ, No One Wants to Dance"
caption:
"Everyone Wants to Be a DJ, No One Wants to Dance"

An essay by the songwriter Dani Offline. She writes that when everyone is a DJ and nobody dances, the work has to get louder just to be seen.

To us, taking part, sharing with others, is spiritual, because we are all connected. And parties are godlike events, spiritual events. People share their energy there, through music and through their bodies, in one of the most primal ways. So try this: go to the party, keep your phone in your pocket, and dance with the people there. When did you last dance with people, phone away?

From "everyone wants to be a DJ, no one wants to dance" by Dani Offline, offline soul, 11 Sep 2025: https://danioffline.substack.com/p/everyone-wants-to-be-a-dj-no-one . Her words are quoted as hers. The sentences about taking part and parties, the "try this" and the question are ours: our words, our view. Dani Offline did not make or endorse this video. Her essay and every NAOS strategy are on the NAOS page linked in our bio.

More strategies: link in bio.

alt: Topographic animation on black. A field of code turns into warm white contour lines. Every character pushes up its own small peak, and small vermilion labels flash on single summits: post, playlist, review, take, draft, reel. The peaks grow tall and sharp, then everything freezes in a short silence. On the kick the spikes melt into one rolling land. It pulses ring to ring like a crowd, and the camera flies low over it. Captions follow the voice, with a small "our words, our view" tag on our sentences. Her quote, "I am most happy when I feel myself exist beyond any fixed identity or role.", appears with "Dani Offline" under it. End card: when did you last dance with people, phone away? and the credit.
